name: Ash Panel
description: Ash Desktop top panel: pinned full-width top panel with the Echo OS dark translucent (glass) background — rgba(20, 20, 24, 70%) with a subtle white bottom border, slightly more opaque while a maximized window is focused. Contents (icons, text, indicators) stay fully opaque. Only the desktop panel is styled; the lock screen and the GDM greeter are not.
